Private beach firework audio sources

Fireworks rocket fired, hiss, explodes — Kolezan
https://freesound.org/people/Kolezan/sounds/132043/
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Changes: excerpt of ascent, mono downmix, resampling, filtering, gain and fades.
The author does not endorse Thru3D. Retain this attribution with derived audio.

fireworks exploding 1.wav — soundmary
https://freesound.org/people/soundmary/sounds/117616/
CC0 1.0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Changes: three isolated explosion excerpts, mono, filtering, gain and brief reflections.

Fireworks Crackle — 16FThumaF
https://freesound.org/people/16FThumaF/sounds/505264/
CC0 1.0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Changes: short crackle excerpts, mono, bandpass/noise suppression, gain and fades.

Downloaded anonymous public high-quality MP3 previews, not the original WAV files.
Exact source hashes and source URLs are in fireworks-sources.json.
Derived files are regenerated by tools/beach/build_firework_audio.py.
Only the independent desktop study currently uses this bank. Future player
integration must carry this credit text into its bundled third-party notices.

NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio
CGI Moon Kit, 2025 color map, lroc_color_2k.jpg (2048 x 1024 JPEG preview).
Visualizer: Ernie Wright (USRA). Scientist: Noah Petro (NASA/GSFC).
Source: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720/
Download: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a004700/a004720/lroc_color_2k.jpg
Usage statement: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/help/
NASA SVS states that its content is public domain unless otherwise noted.
This color-map item has no separate restricted-use notice. No NASA logos used.

Source download is unchanged; its SHA256 is recorded in source.json.
Desktop runtime adaptation: resize to 512 x 256, mipmaps, ETC2 roundtrip,
near-side spherical projection, modest full-moon shading and scene exposure.
This is the visualization color-map preview, not raw scientific reflectance data.
The full-moon orbit and upright orientation are artistic, not an ephemeris.
Retain this credit when the derived asset is later packaged for the player.
